thread.title: Dow stages post-Fed-meeting retrenchment as Apple's stock slide exacts 20-point toll

author: Mark DeCambre
title: Dow stages post-Fed-meeting retrenchment as Apple's stock slide exacts 20-point toll
text: The Dow Jones Industrial Average gave up firmer gains to close out Wednesday trade, as shares of Apple Inc. fell sharply. Apples shares AAPL, -2.27% finished down 2.3%, or $3.97, cutting about 27 points from the price-weighted average. A $1 move in any one of the benchmark's components equates to a swing of 6.89 points. The Dow ended the volatile session down by about 45 points, or 0.2%, at 24,682, while the S&P 500 index SPX, -0.18% closed off 0.2% at 2,711. The technology-laden Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.26% wrapped off 0.3% at 7,345. All of the benchmarks had enjoyed firmer gains in the immediate aftermath of the Federal Reserve's updated policy statement and quarter-point rate increase, moves that had been expected.
